stem: A room is no longer under an active pesticide application, but a posted restricted-entry interval has not expired. The production schedule assigns a routine plant task there. What should determine whether the technician enters?
choices: The task schedule, because the application itself has ended
Whether extra PPE is available, even if the worker is not authorized for an exception
The controlling label/restricted-entry status and the worker's current authorization under the applicable procedure
Whether another technician already entered the room without reporting a problem
rationale: Ending the application does not automatically end post-application entry restrictions. The technician verifies the current label-based restricted-entry status and role authorization; production schedules or improvised PPE do not create permission to enter.
